
  ╭─────────────────────────────────────────────╮
  │  /background  (/bg)                         │
  │  Background Jobs                            │
  ╰─────────────────────────────────────────────╯

  Summary:
    View and manage background sub-agent jobs.

  Usage:
    /background
    /bg
    /bg<N>

  Details:
    Lists background sub-agent jobs with status and runtime.
    Use /bg<N> (e.g. /bg2) to view the result of job N.
    Job results are also injected into the conversation when done.

  Examples:
    $ /background
    $ /bg1

  Related: /job
